entries.title: Click your first mate's reply to read all of it
entries.body: The first mate's reply above the message box is now a button. Click it, or press Enter or Space on it, and the whole reply opens as a note in front of your cards, with its line breaks as the first mate wrote them and your message as its title. Close it with × or Esc. Open the first mate's reply in command search opens it too, even after the line has faded.

picture.alt: A note titled with the captain's question in quotation marks, showing the first mate's reply as a short list, above the reply line and the message box
